title: Another Blueprint In The Wall: How to Ask Frontier AI Like a Kid?
abstract: arXiv:2609.14803v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper reports experiments across six frontier model types from OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, and Google DeepMind. Ten independent sessions per model type used the same three stage prompt sequence, progressing from architectural preference to a full ASCII backbone. Under the school audience framing, responses repeatedly converged on a shared architectural pattern built around persistent latent state, adaptive computation, memory, specialist routing, verification, stopping control, and delayed decoding. Most runs remained close to this common structure, while a small number developed markedly greater engineering specificity. The audience framing appears to be an important condition of this effect. In additional control runs that removed the school framing while retaining the architectural request, responses became substantially more heterogeneous and failed to reproduce the same stable motif convergence. translated_title: 墙内的另一张蓝图：如何像孩子一样向前沿AI提问？
translated_abstract: 本文报告了在来自OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI和Google DeepMind的六种前沿模型类型上开展的实验。每种模型类型进行十次独立会话，采用相同的三阶段提示序列，从架构偏好逐步推进到完整的ASCII骨干架构图。在学校听众的框架设定下，模型的回复反复收敛于一种共享的架构模式，该模式围绕持久潜在状态、自适应计算、记忆、专家路由、验证、停止控制和延迟解码构建。大多数运行结果都接近这一共同结构，而少数运行则展现出明显更强的工程具体性。听众框架似乎是产生这一效应的重要条件。在移除学校框架但保留架构请求的额外对照运行中，回复变得显著更加多样化，未能再现同样的稳定主题收敛。其中一项观察结果尤为引人注目……
tldr: 以“给小学生讲解”的听众框架向前沿大模型提问架构设计，能让OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI和Google DeepMind的多款模型收敛到相似的AI架构蓝图，而移除该框架则回复显著多样化，说明听众框架是引导模型输出一致性的关键条件。
en_tdlr: Framing architecture-design prompts as explanations for schoolchildren causes frontier AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, and Google DeepMind to converge on a shared architectural blueprint (persistent latent state, adaptive computation, etc.), while removing this framing yields substantially more heterogeneous responses, highlighting audience framing as a key condition for stable output convergence.
